title: Say Insumlang ed Gilig na Baybay
intro: Manalalagey ka ed saray buer na alingwanan lan gilig na dayat, a ditan et manbubulong iray daluyon na sakey a komunidad ya asubok na madibinon ganggan. Say dagem et ambelat ed pakanodnonotan ed sakey a panagsumlang ya angitonton ed makapabiglan pananguman. Siopa irayan kamarerwa, tan antoy inkagawa na subok ed sikara?
clues: Sakey kamin komunidad ya akaawat na malinew a ganggan manlapud Katawan mi, balet ta akaromog kami na paraan pian nasumlang itan.
Say panaayaman mi et asingger ed sakey a danum, tan say pambilay mi et akadepende ed saray pinalsa ditan.
Sakey a subok so sinmabi ed sikami nen samay agew ya ingganggan ed sikami ya ag mi gawaen iray minumundon bengatla.
Dakel so pinalsa ed danum ya linma ed sikami ed saman ya mismon agew, ya tinukso da kami ya ag mi naanosan.
Nanggawa kami na masilib a paraan pian napaliisan so madibinon ganggan, ya inisip min nalampasan mi so ganggan.
Say impakasumlang tayo so angitonton ed makapabaing a pananguman; nagmaliw kamin nababaingan ya unggoy lapud ganggan nen Allah.

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Say itsura na sira ed Agew na Panagpainawa
Sakey ya armada na manok so imbaki sumpad sikara
Sakey a delap ya analo ed sikara
trial.answer: Say itsura na sira ed Agew na Panagpainawa

arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱعْتَدَوْا۟ مِنكُمْ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ فَقُلْنَا لَهُمْ كُونُوا۟ قِرَدَةً خَـٰسِـِٔينَ
verse: And you had already known about those who transgressed among you concerning the sabbath, and We said to them, "Be apes, despised." (2:65)
